Job Summary

Role Overview - Looking for a Prompt Engineering professional with strong experience in Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications to develop effective prompts and improve Generative AI solution performance.

Responsibilities
Design, develop, and optimize prompts for LLM-based applications.
Work with RAG architectures and LLMs to improve response quality.
Develop prompt templates, system instructions, and evaluation strategies.
Experiment with different prompting techniques and LLM models.
Analyze model responses and identify opportunities for improvement.
Collaborate with AI/ML and development teams on Generative AI solutions.
Work with embeddings, vector databases, retrieval pipelines, and context optimization.
Perform prompt testing and evaluation for accuracy, relevance, and consistency.
Document prompt engineering approaches, standards, and best practices.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Strong experience in Prompt Engineering and Generative AI applications.
Strong understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) and RAG architectures.
Hands-on experience with prompt design, optimization, and evaluation.
Understanding of embeddings, vector databases, retrieval pipelines, and context management.
Experience analyzing and improving LLM responses for accuracy, relevance, and consistency.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working with multiple LLM models and prompting techniques.
Experience developing reusable prompt templates and system instructions.
Experience with GenAI evaluation frameworks and automated prompt testing.
Experience collaborating with AI/ML engineers and software development teams.
